contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [--]NSTAN [?]S PF AVG ; R/ VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ [NN]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constans (333-350); Two Victories, possibly a small module copy, issue of 347-348, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust diademed right, large eye. Obverse inscription: [--]NSTAN [?]S PF AVG. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding up wreaths. Reverse inscription: VICTORIAE DD AVGGQ [NN]. Diameter: 16.4mm, Weight: 0.86gms, die axis: 6
